historicalUniverseWarning: Same-day closing turnover is ex-post information. Historical reconstruction is not proof of an executable morning universe.
comparisonRule: Variant comparison is preliminary until >=20 trading days and >=30 baseline trades. Each variant's design date is excluded.

multipleTesting.note: Diagnostic correction only; no strategy is auto-promoted.

adoptionRule: OOS edge > 0 and variant beats baseline in a majority of completed OOS folds; no auto-promotion.
signalModelNote: Signal decisions remain 1-minute close based for live parity. Research records close and low/high exit models in parallel; official compatibility fields remain close model.

exitModelComparison.note: Research comparison only. Baseline signal thresholds are not auto-changed.

diagnostics.outcomeModel: KIS 1m high/low from the bar after entry for MFE/MAE/threshold; close for 5/10/20/30m marks

walkForward.adoptionRule: OOS edge > 0 and variant beats baseline in a majority of completed OOS folds; no auto-promotion.
walkForward.note: Out-of-sample only. Design dates are excluded per variant. No strategy is automatically promoted from this result.

validation.note: Opening-price screen only, not proof of corporate-action or volume consistency. No prices are rescaled and no signals are removed. Resolve source conventions before adoption.
